basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old tech enthusiast from Melbourne, Australia. By day, I work as a junior software developer at a local startup, and by night, I dive deep into the world of gaming and cryptocurrency. I love exploring new technologies and have a keen interest in game physics and mechanics. When I'm not online, you can find me catching waves at the beach or fiddling with my Raspberry Pi projects. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom to explore new hobbies and interests. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and late into the night during weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science, having graduated from the University of Melbourne. My passion for gaming led me to explore game development and mechanics, though I’m still learning the ropes when it comes to the intricacies of PvP combat in games like Star Citizen. I also have a burgeoning interest in blockchain technologies, which I explore through various online courses and forums.
